```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Clone repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Dart
        uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - name: Set up Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          dart pub get
          cd examples/counter
          dart pub get

      - name: Verify pubspec paths
        run: |
          # Check that example pubspec has correct path to marionette_flutter
          EXAMPLE_PUBSPEC="examples/counter/pubspec.yaml"
          if ! grep -q "../../packages/marionette_flutter" "$EXAMPLE_PUBSPEC"; then
            echo "ERROR: Example pubspec.yaml does not contain correct path to marionette_flutter"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Generate version
        run: dart tool/generate_version.dart

      - name: Validate version.g.dart
        run: |
          if ! git diff --exit-code packages/marionette_mcp/lib/src/version.g.dart; then
            echo "ERROR: version.g.dart is out of sync. Please run 'dart tool/generate_version.dart' and commit the changes."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Run code analysis
        run: dart analyze --fatal-infos

      - name: Run tests
        run: dart test

      - name: Run security checks
        run: |
          dart pub global activate dart_code_metrics
          dart pub global run dart_code_metrics:analyze lib --reporter=checkstyle > metrics.xml || true
          dart pub global deactivate dart_code_metrics

      - name: Check for symlink issues
        run: |
          # Ensure no symlinks exist in examples directory
          find examples -type l | head -n 10 | while read link; do
            echo "ERROR: Found symlink in examples directory: $link"
            exit 1
          done
```
